goblin_ambush.description: Goblin attack upon first arrival at lighthouse

payload.text:
As you approach the lighthouse, a grotesque creature emerges from the shadows!

It's humanoid but twisted, with mottled green skin and sharp, yellowed teeth. A goblin—your first encounter with the effects of Night Shadow.

set_goblin_encounter_flag.description: Mark that the goblin encounter has happened

initiate_keeper_dialog.description: Start conversation with lighthouse keeper through intercom

check_lighthouse_access.description: Check if player was granted access and unlock door if true

unlock_lighthouse_door.description: Unlock the lighthouse door and add exit

payload.text:
*CLICK*

You hear the heavy mechanism of the door unlock. The lighthouse is now accessible.

update_door_state.description: Update door interactable to unlocked state

interactables.name: door
interactables.description: A heavy metal door. It's now unlocked.

actions.examine: display_text:The door is now unlocked. You could enter the lighthouse.
actions.open: display_text:You pull the heavy door open. The way inside is clear.
